content: Prefers weekly digest emails on Mondays at 08:30 PT; avoid Friday afternoon pings.
Billing contact: AP goes to billing@northwindanalytics.com; PO required for annual renewals.
Ran `poetry install` in repo and it failed due to Python 3.11 constraint; needs 3.10 in CI.
Client wants SOC 2 report shared via Vanta portal; NDA already on file (DocuSign envelope 8452).
User likes answers with code snippets first, then brief explanation; dislikes long preambles.
Local Docker daemon on macOS using colima; default profile is `colima start --cpu 4 --memory 8`.
On-call runbook: if `queue_depth` > 500 for 10m, restart consumer group `ingest-workers` and page #sre-ops.
Customer uses Okta SSO; SCIM provisioning enabled. Group mapping: Okta group `mem0-prod` -> role `member`.
Primary datasets live in BigQuery project `acme-ml-prod`; cost alerts at $2,500/month via Cloud Billing.
Meeting notes: migrate from Redis 6 to 7; enable ACLs and set `maxmemory-policy allkeys-lru`.
Preferred vendors: SendGrid for transactional email; Postmark as fallback for deliverability incidents.
Support SLA: enterprise customers get first response within 2 hours during business days (9-5 ET).
Kubernetes namespace `mem0-prod` has HPA on `api` deployment; min 3, max 12 replicas, target CPU 70%.
Q2 OKRs: reduce p95 search latency from 420ms to <250ms; increase cache hit rate to 85%.
Customer requested export in Parquet with Snappy compression; column `event_time` must be UTC ISO-8601.
Incident 2026-06-01: spike in 429s from /v1/search after enabling new rate limiter; rolled back config within 12m.
VPN troubleshooting: if split-tunnel breaks, renew DHCP lease and flush DNS; on Windows run `ipconfig /flushdns`.
Temporary API base URL for staging is https://staging.mem0.ai/v1 ; prod remains https://api.mem0.ai/v1.
Do not store raw access tokens in memories; redact to last 4 chars and record token hash only.
Release checklist: bump version, run unit+integration tests, tag `vX.Y.Z`, publish docker image, update changelog.
